trust: client_reported; key possession authenticates the sender, not filesystem state or Hermes consumption
trigger: after successful atomic journal application leaves the exact full remote baseline in local files with no pending or conflicted content updates; never on download alone or partial application preserving local changes
time: server received_at only; no client-supplied time; equal or lower retries never refresh it
validation: nonnegative safe-integer revision; at most owner server head; monotonic per installation; no browser submissions

installation_id
storage.retention: latest report retained with installation and revocation metadata without automatic expiry

readers: company administrator for installation metadata only
separation: D1 installation metadata; no persona R2 read or content storage; no audit/OTLP event or relay accounting writes
limitations: historical application report; later local changes, unresolved conflicts, rollback and Hermes in-memory state are not observed; sync attempt outcomes use the separate public audit/OTLP activity contract
